_comment: Model manifest. One entry per model family the engine is tested against.
WHY THIS EXISTS: the artifacts on disk have different ROLES, and the roles were
undocumented — a '.gguf' looked like a spare copy of a '.tmq' when it is actually
the baseline instrument a published number depends on. Every artifact here carries
a 'role' and a 'required' flag, so 'can I delete this?' is answerable by reading.
SOURCES are tried in order. 'dir' first by default: a folder you already have on
the machine or on the local network is the cheapest and fastest source, and it is
the only one that costs no bandwidth. Override with --root or $TM_MODEL_ROOT.
Sizes are the download/transfer size, used to refuse a fetch that will not fit.

tinyllama.role: The llama.cpp side of the published end-to-end table, and the fixture the grammar, embedding and HTTP-shim gates drive.

tokenizer.model.role: SentencePiece vocabulary — the grammar mask iterates its pieces, so this one must be real even when the weights are a fixture

tinyllama-1.1b-chat-v1.0.Q4_0.gguf.role: BASELINE INSTRUMENT, not a spare copy. tensormark/bench_all.sh runs llama-bench on it to produce the published prefill/decode baselines, and it is the source the .tmq was converted from — deleting it makes two headline rows unverifiable

ref_logits32.npy.role: numerics reference for the fp32 gate

sources.note: cheap route: the GGUF is a quarter the size of the safetensors and converts block-exact

gpt2.role: The from-scratch training and SFT path — the small model the autograd demo trains.

model.safetensors.role: the conversion source; safe to drop once converted

sources.note: transpose: GPT-2 stores Conv1D weights (in, out)

qwen25.role: The dense/GQA control at 3B — the baseline qwen35's hybrid path is measured against.

qwen35.role: The hybrid Gated-DeltaNet architecture — the only checkpoint that exercises gdn.h and block_linear.

qwen35_0.8b_q40.f16lm.tmq.role: fp16 lm_head variant — the equal-precision instrument for the fp16 decode lane, not a duplicate of the Q4_0 file

Qwen3.5-0.8B-Q4_0.gguf.role: the porting validation source named by docs/QWEN35_PORT.md; no script reads it, so this is the one artifact here that is documentation rather than an instrument

sources.note: resolved against `ollama list` at plan time rather than a hardcoded tag

qwen35-4b.role: Qwen3.5-4B — the NEWEST generation that has a variant this 8 GB host holds, and what `llama_chat_metal` loads when given no arguments. Same architecture as the 0.8B (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, head_dim 256, full_attention_interval 4, 3 linear : 1 full), one width wider, so it runs on the already-verified qwen35 path rather than needing a new port. Qwen3.8's smallest is the 27B (probed: 3.8-{2,4,8,14,32}B all absent).

qwen35_4b_q40.tmq.role: Q4_0 weights (32 layers: 8 full-attention + 24 linear, hidden 2560)

Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_0.gguf.role: the conversion source; keep only if you want to re-derive the .tmq or diff it against llama.cpp

also.why: llama.h reads config.json beside the .tmq for the qwen35 geometry (layer_types, head_dim); the GGUF repo does not carry it

sources.note: Q4_0, not the Q4_K_M default tag — convert_gguf accepts Q4_0/Q8_0 block layouts block-exact and rejects K-quants by design

qwen38-4b.role: A Qwen3.8 at a size this host can hold. The official Qwen3.8 line is 27B-only (probed: 3.8-{2,4,8,14,32}B are all absent; the 27B is 15.6 GB at Q4_0 and dense, so it needs ~16 GB of RAM), but the community distilled 3.8 into 4B and 9B — and the 4B distill is model_type=qwen3_5 with the SAME geometry as the Qwen3.5-4B already running here (32 layers, 8 full / 24 linear, hidden 2560, head_dim 256). Same port, no new work.

qwen38_4b_q6k.tmq.role: Q6_K weights (3.89 GB, 442 tensors). Q8_0 was tried first and does not fit this host: 5.03 GB of weights on 8 GB of unified memory drove 2.99 GB of the 4 GB swap into use and left the engine in uninterruptible I/O, because every pass re-reads the weight file from disk instead of holding it resident. Q6_K converts and runs — measured peak RSS 5.60 GB at the default auto-sized 16384 context, 4.71 GB at TM_CTX=4096; both are higher than the Qwen3.5-4B Q4_0 lane (4.64 GB), so drop to TM_CTX=4096 when a browser is open

Qwen3.8-4B-Q6_K.gguf.role: the conversion source (3.32 GB) — safe to drop once converted, and re-fetchable from the source below

also.why: llama.h reads config.json beside the .tmq for the qwen3_5 geometry

sources.note: a community distill of 3.8, not an official release — the official line starts at 27B. The repo also ships Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M/Q8_0; Q8_0 is too large for this host and Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M use block layouts convert_gguf rejects, so Q6_K is the one that both fits and converts
